claim_review_2026.primary_title: Hilbert's tenth problem over the rational numbers
claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: No algorithm decides whether an arbitrary integer-coefficient polynomial, with the number of variables part of the input, has a rational zero.
claim_review_2026.scope_note: This is the same rational-field decision problem, not the already-settled integer version or undecidability for proper subrings of Q.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: Unrefereed manuscript; proof depends on companion pointwise elliptic 2-converse, valuation and height arguments. No independent line-by-line verification located.
